title: Seeded and uniform verification probabilities
statement: Let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The acceptance probability for the seeded test whose seed maps a uniformly random Boolean vector of length $n$ coordinatewise to $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ equals the acceptance probability for the test on a uniformly random $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, where each test accepts exactly when $C'x=A(Bx)$.
hypotheses_covered: The seed map is the coordinatewise Boolean-to-$\mathbb{F}_2$ equivalence
